title: The event-driven resolution shape
description: Events announce that an eligibility input may have changed; the resolver does work when it is needed instead of rediscovering every fact on every update.

nodes.title: Relevant state changes
nodes.detail: Time, cell, combat, target, quest, or settings state changes.

nodes.title: Mark or request resolution
nodes.detail: Invalidate the derived answer at the boundary that owns it.

nodes.title: Resolution work
nodes.detail: Ask the generic selection mechanism for the best eligible playlist.

nodes.title: Playback sequencing
nodes.detail: Updates that genuinely need time continue through the normal update path.
